duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Course at East China University of Science and Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. scan copy of passport 2. scan copy of visa (to the foreign students in China) 3. CV 4. scan copy of highest degree graduation certificate and transcript

requirements.text: Hold a valid ordinary foreign passport Age range: 16 - 60 years old, in good health. For those who are under 18 years old on August 31 of the application year, a guarantee letter from a Chinese or foreign adult guardian residing in China (download the guardian guarantee letter template from the download center page) is required. The Chinese language training courses for students offer zero-level and beginner-level classes. The beginner-level classes require applicants to have a HSK level of 2 or 3; the business Chinese language course requires applicants to have a HSK level of 4.
